author: Annie Duke, interviewed by Lenny Rachitsky
basis: Professional facilitation experience and sales-team example
reported_outcomes: Reports organizations adopting independent-input routines; describes warning signals paired with actions for a sales team. No controlled effect estimate.
proposed_outcomes: Expose differences before discussion; precommit to action when failure signals appear.
limits: Feeling heard and reaching consensus are different; disagreement can remain.
A facilitator still has power over framing and synthesis.
The sales kill criteria are contextual examples, not rules for every project.
review_note: Retain independent input; merge advance stopping actions into Doshi’s premortem card as a distinct contribution, not independent validation.
coverage: Close-read complete relevant transcript exchanges at listed timestamps and surrounding context; not full 491-line transcript; audio/video not reviewed.
